# ONTO claims-addendum v3 independent audit

18 October 2026. USD millions except shares (millions) and per-share USD. Claims-only research review, not financial-statement assurance.

## Decision

Qualified pass for integration as a dated EV-first presentation and an explicitly conditional common-allocation calculator. No accepted intrinsic per-share estimate, current-equity value, price target, or publication authorization follows. One narrow freshness qualification is required: the claim that the live quarterly-results page still lists Q2 as latest was not independently established. Its retained fetch records HTTP 403; this audit's live web extraction showed only the dynamic page shell. Prefer “Q2 is the latest report retained and reviewed here” unless separate successful primary evidence is attached. This does not impede a June-origin model or require unreported October balances.

All 148 executable checks pass. All 123 pre-existing files were preserved during this review. The original v2 audit's 91-input baseline, all 14 addendum-manifest entries, 10 retained source hashes and all three PDF-to-text extractions verify. Author builders and author replay were not executed. This audit separately reconstructs claim arithmetic and all 14 isolated sensitivities. It incorporates the prior qualified operating audit; it does not rerun or newly attest its 110 operating checks, 262 fact checks or 191 annual observations.

## Findings accepted

1. Reported June common shares reconcile: 49.702 + .073 − .031 + .124 − .805 − .030 = 49.033. This is a rounded reported share count, not EPS-weighted dilution or July's 49.074247. The extra .750 legacy equivalent units remain hypothetical, yielding 49.783 solely for the illustration.
2. Cash 1,253.205 plus securities 628.945, less analyst operating reserve 33.60411, convertible fair value 1,982.250 and unpaid costs 2.050 + 1.941 + .678 produce −138.37311. Full convertible fair value is deducted once. Neither 1,500 principal, 1,471.731 carrying value nor the terminated 500 commitment is an additional deduction. Convertible shares are not also added.
3. Capped-call value remains unknown. Historical 88.95 premium is a demonstration credit, not measured value; already-paid premium is not deducted again. Nominal 499.9948032 is a contract-based stress, not a measured asset or universal bound. No second dilution offset is applied. Legacy awards, ESPP, tax/capital/deferred-compensation residuals and private recovery remain explicit unmeasured inputs. Future grant economic cost stays in margins.
4. The 1.284 FX forward asset is outside cash/securities. Gross credit and net economic benefit differ; separate zero central credit and gross unoffset stress are appropriate pending exposure, settlements and tax mapping.
5. Rigaku's April issuer disclosure supports transfer-consent and acquisition/voting-agreement restrictions during an unspecified period, ratio-maintenance subscription rights and a director recommendation right at the stated half-original-holding threshold. These do not establish control, unrestricted liquidity, intrinsic value, a quantified lock-up, or any numeric liquidity discount.
6. Rigaku's September 30 notice reports a September 29 agreement for all 61,123,436 shares to move to wholly owned Onto Japan, scheduled October 1. Parent indirect holding and subsidiary accession to the alliance with Rigaku consent are explicit. The 26.99% uses August 31 voting rights. It is not an external sale, fresh external acquisition or evidence of additional 720 expenditure. The notice alone does not establish consummation. A lower displayed percentage is not evidence of disposal.
7. Approximate 720 purchase consideration is historical cost. Onto's live issuer closing announcement supports fair-value-option accounting without consolidation, but not current fair value. For June-origin allocation, the future purchase and asset legs remain paired; their net present value is an unknown parameter. Zero means the illustrative at-cost convention only. For a later origin, reconcile already-paid purchase in cash before any deduction. Do not double count the asset, payment or operating earnings.

## Reproduced values and scope

Operating EVs are 2,642.611928527 / 5,867.221927683 / 10,231.558180085. They remain June cash-flow-origin scenarios using October discount inputs, not synchronized June knowledge or current October enterprise valuations. The prior 20bp occupancy stress remains 5,820.833166904 base EV, down 46.388760779; it is not a measured incremental lease schedule.

Conditional allocation is (EV − 138.37311 + capped calls + private recovery − residual claims − ESPP + net Rigaku PV + net FX) / (49.033 + legacy equivalent units). The same illustrative inputs of 88.95 / 8 / 15 / 3 / .750 and zero net Rigaku/FX produce 51.88897452 / 116.66229070 / 204.32949139, or $51.89 / $116.66 / $204.33. The prior $47.57 downside is different because it includes a 70%-of-cost Rigaku value stress: a 30% haircut, not a 70% haircut. Its −216 future amount discounted for 41 days at 4.87% reduces each same-bridge value by $4.31571697. This convention is not a risk-adjusted minority fair-value range.

All isolated sensitivities reproduce. Fixed convertible value across operating cases is a transparent conditional device; a complete intrinsic security repricing would need internally consistent security and option treatment. There is no current quote, trading recommendation, invented October cash balance, or implied best-estimate midpoint. A calculator is ready only when unknown inputs remain exposed and illustrations remain labeled. EV-only presentation can proceed with dates and the governing operating caveats. Missing current measurements prevent validated current/common value, not retrospective conditional work.

## Sources and limits

Reviewed original retained SEC Q2 extract, prior audit and source records, issuer closing announcement (live reopening), and all three newly retained issuer PDFs. PDF extraction was independently repeated and exact bytes match the retained extracts. Sources used for new claims are issuers or SEC, not secondary commentary. Hashes establish preservation, not source truth. Live SEC and Onto closing-release reopening succeeded; live Rigaku PDF reopening through web returned an internal error, so Rigaku findings rely on the preserved issuer PDFs and their official disclosure-page/index provenance. Live quarterly-page freshness was not verified. None of these claims requires a current quote.

## Reproduce

Run `python independent-audit-v3/replay.py` from this company directory, or its absolute path from anywhere. Python standard library and pdftotext are required. Output is restricted to this audit folder. Original research, addendum, source files and prior audits are unchanged. No Site was edited.
